sources.title: The Elliott and Connolly Benchmark: A Test for Evaluating the In-Hand Dexterity of Robot Hands
sources.organization: IEEE-RAS International Conference on Humanoid Robots; Carnegie Mellon University
sources.specific_reference: Abstract and Section I-A identify 13 distinct, daily-life-derived, hand-only manipulation patterns without arm or body; Section II-A defines binary Success/Failure and the translation/rotation metrics; Table II fixes the manipulation objects; Section II-B defines the start-to-target protocol, at least three successful trials, unlimited source retries, and no timing requirement; Appendix I gives the separate criteria for Pinch, Dynamic Tripod, Squeeze, Twiddle, Rock, Rock II, Radial Roll, Index Roll, Full Roll, Rotary Step, Interdigital Step, Linear Step, and Palmar Slide.

sources.title: Gymnasium-Robotics Shadow Dexterous Hand task protocols
sources.specific_reference: reach.py defines the concatenated fingertip Cartesian L2 success error below 0.01 m; manipulate.py defines position error below 0.01 m AND quaternion-angle error below 0.1 rad; manipulate_block.py defines the full block-pose operation and target-offset ranges; envs/assets/hand/manipulate_block.xml defines 0.025 m cube half-extents; gymnasium_robotics/__init__.py registers HandReach-v3 for 50 steps and HandManipulateBlockFull-v1 for 100 steps.

sources.title: ROBEL D'Claw task protocols
sources.specific_reference: pose.py defines fixed joint-pose matching and mean absolute error below 10*pi/180 rad; turn.py defines a single fixed valve turn from 0 to pi rad with wrapped target error below 0.1 rad; screw.py defines continuous fixed target motion at 0.5 rad/s with target-position error below 0.2 rad; __init__.py registers 80-step/4 s Pose, 40-step/4 s Turn, and 80-step/8 s Screw episodes.

sources.title: MyoSuite hand task implementations
sources.specific_reference: myobase/obj_hold_v0.py defines solved as object-goal distance below 0.010 m and drop as distance above 0.300 m; env_base.py evaluate_success requires more than five solved steps; myobase/__init__.py registers a 75-step fixed hold. myochallenge/baoding_v1.py defines two-ball counter-clockwise trajectory tracking, 0.015 m per-ball proximity, no-fall conjunction, fixed 5 s period with 0.025 m and 0.028 m radii, nominal 0.022 m ball radius and 0.043 kg mass, and mean solved-fraction scoring; myochallenge/__init__.py registers the fixed P1 task for 200 steps.
